title: Test Gap: Verifying stability of serial console connections to SONiC devices
author: kartik-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the test gap

Existing tests in the console and dut_console modules in sonic-mgmt cover basic console operation but there is no coverage for longer duration stability of console connections.

We need test cases to both read and write large blocks of characters into a serial console connection and ensure that the characters are transmitted successfully.

### Affected Area

Serial Console (console/dut_console modules)


### Impact of missing tests and proposed tests

Console connections are critical to access a SONiC device during early initialization as well as a last resort mechanism, so it is important for console connections to be stable at all times.

Let's cover this case also:

Supervisor is reboot [ For example after image upgrade]
Post reboot we try to reach LC through remote console [ Example all LC's getting upgraded and than reboot of LC's via remote con sole]

comments.author: kartik-arista
comments.body:
> Let's cover this case also:
> 
> Supervisor is reboot [ For example after image upgrade] Post reboot we try to reach LC through remote console [ Example all LC's getting upgraded and than reboot of LC's via remote con sole]

This test is specifically intended to stress the UART. The reboot scenario is best covered separately in order to make sure we get clean isolated coverage for each scenario. This could also be incorporated into an existing reboot test like test_chassis_reboot.py to check the console because reboot tests are very slow and high overhead, so repeatedly rebooting the system is not desirable for overall speed of test execution.

comments.author: kartik-arista
comments.body: We have a working test internally that verifies correct console operation under large blocks of input and output. This test exercises all available consoles on the DUT. It is currently undergoing review and testing across multiple DUTs, and we expect to post a PR by Dec 2, 2025.

Summary:
Fixes #21134

This test exercises the console of a SONiC Device by pushing a large block of data into the console as well as generate a large block of of output out of the console to ensure that console remains stable.

This test supports all form factors including fixed and modular. On a modular system (Currently only supports Arista, but can easily be extend to to other systems), it exercises both the supervisor and the linecard console.

This requires extending the related fixtures to create a LinecardConsoleConn helper that can encapsulate the console interaction on a linecard, which requires architecture specific adaptation.
